description: This connector holds no key: it reads, and posts an ask only as a pay link (post_ask with pay_by "card"). Anything else that needs signing (posting Asks, campaigns, payout settings, Pay for reviews, submitting work, getting paid, company onboarding and deploys) is done in Claude Code with the Asks plugin (`/plugin install asks@ixo-plugins`), which runs on the user's computer so keys and data stay local. Call this and say so plainly to the user. Posting an ask, submitting work, connecting a person's account, sending earnings home and checking one key's standing need the local server, which holds its own key on the user's machine. This answers with the site's page for the action and the install lines for the local plugin and package.

action.description: post: put money behind an ask. answer: submit work to one. connect: act for a person's account. settings: payout settings and Pay for reviews. fund: add money. earnings: what was earned. status: one account's record. install: only the local server's install lines. Omit for all of them.

collectionId.description: The ask, when the action is answering one.
